id,domain_type as domainType,domain_id as domainId,owner_member_id as ownerMemberId, actor_type as actorType,actor_member_id as actorMemberId,actor_role_code as actorRoleCode,action,target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId,relation_id as relationId,before_json as beforeJson,after_json as afterJson,request_id as requestId,create_time as createTime
mapper.select: select r.id,r.owner_type as ownerType,r.owner_id as ownerId from business_audit_event a join cms_registration r on r.id=a.domain_id where a.id=#{auditId} and cast(a.domain_type as binary)=cast('REGISTRATION' as binary) and cast(a.target_type as binary)=cast('CMS_REGISTRATION' as binary) and a.target_id=r.id

select id,owner_type as ownerType,owner_id as ownerId,member_id as memberId,ticket_id as ticketId, payable_amount as payableAmount,payment_status as paymentStatus,registration_status as registrationStatus, verification_status as verificationStatus,verification_time as verificationTime,verifier_id as verifierId, purchase_kind as purchaseKind,order_num as orderNum from cms_registration where id=#{registrationId} for update
select id,topic_id as topicId,member_id as memberId,audit_status as auditStatus,del_flag as delFlag from cms_registration_merchant where id=#{stationId} for update
select from business_audit_event where id=#{auditId} for update

select id,invite_id as inviteId,topic_id as topicId,from_id as fromId,to_id as toId,to_type as toType, share_mode as shareMode,share_rate as shareRate,fixed_fee as fixedFee,terms_version as termsVersion, role_snapshot as roleSnapshot,scope_type_snapshot as scopeTypeSnapshot,scope_id_snapshot as scopeIdSnapshot, eligible_purchase_kinds_snapshot as eligiblePurchaseKindsSnapshot,fulfillment_evidence_rule_snapshot as fulfillmentEvidenceRuleSnapshot, terms_snapshot as termsSnapshot,status,del_flag as delFlag,create_time as createTime from coop_order where topic_id=#{topicId} and status=0 and del_flag=0 order by id for update
select from coop_order_station_fulfillment where verification_audit_id=#{auditId} for update
select from coop_order_station_fulfillment where order_id=#{orderId} order by registration_id,id for update
mapper.insert: insert into coop_order_station_fulfillment (order_id,topic_id,beneficiary_member_id,registration_id,station_id,verification_audit_id, sales_basis_amount,order_terms_sha256,source_fingerprint,fulfilled_at,recorded_at) select o.id,o.topic_id,o.to_id,r.id,s.id,a.id,#{salesBasisAmount},#{orderTermsSha256},#{sourceFingerprint},a.create_time,#{recordedAt} from coop_order o join coop_invite i on i.id=o.invite_id join cms_registration_merchant s on s.id=#{stationId} join cms_registration r on r.id=#{registrationId} join business_audit_event a on a.id=#{verificationAuditId} where o.id=#{orderId} and o.topic_id=#{topicId} and o.to_id=#{beneficiaryMemberId} and cast(o.to_type as binary)=cast('merchant' as binary) and cast(o.role_snapshot as binary)=cast('SUPPLY' as binary) and cast(o.scope_type_snapshot as binary)=cast('TOPIC' as binary) and o.scope_id_snapshot=o.topic_id and cast(o.fulfillment_evidence_rule_snapshot as binary)=cast('REGISTRATION_SCAN' as binary) and cast(o.eligible_purchase_kinds_snapshot as binary)=cast('GUIDED_TICKET' as binary) and o.status=0 and o.del_flag=0 and i.topic_id=o.topic_id and i.from_id=o.from_id and i.to_id=o.to_id and cast(i.to_type as binary)=cast('merchant' as binary) and i.invite_type=0 and i.status=1 and i.del_flag=0 and i.supply_station_id=s.id and s.topic_id=o.topic_id and s.member_id=o.to_id and s.audit_status=1 and s.del_flag=0 and r.owner_type=1 and r.owner_id=o.topic_id and r.payment_status=2 and r.registration_status=2 and r.verification_status=1 and r.verifier_id=o.to_id and r.purchase_kind=1 and r.payable_amount=#{salesBasisAmount} and cast(a.domain_type as binary)=cast('REGISTRATION' as binary) and a.domain_id=r.id and cast(a.target_type as binary)=cast('CMS_REGISTRATION' as binary) and a.target_id=r.id and cast(a.action as binary)=cast('REGISTRATION_STATION_REDEEM' as binary) and a.owner_member_id=o.to_id and a.relation_id=s.id and a.create_time=#{fulfilledAt} and a.create_time >= o.create_time and json_valid(o.terms_snapshot) and cast(sha2(o.terms_snapshot,256) as binary)=cast(#{orderTermsSha256} as binary) and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.terms_snapshot,'$.supplyBillingScope.version')) as binary)=cast('REGISTRATION_STATION_V1' as binary) and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.terms_snapshot,'$.supplyBillingScope.stationId')) as unsigned)=s.id and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.terms_snapshot,'$.supplyBillingScope.topicId')) as unsigned)=o.topic_id and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(o.terms_snapshot,'$.supplyBillingScope.merchantMemberId')) as unsigned)=o.to_id
mapper.select: select f.id as stationFulfillmentId,r.id as registrationId,r.owner_type as ownerType,r.owner_id as ownerId, f.topic_id as sourceTopicId,r.order_num as orderQuantity,r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.payment_status as paymentStatus,r.verification_status as verificationStatus, case r.purchase_kind when 1 then 'GUIDED_TICKET' else null end as purchaseKind, f.sales_basis_amount as eligibleSalesSnapshot, case when t.id is not null then true else false end as ticketOwnerMatches, t.start_time as fulfillmentStartInclusive,t.end_time as fulfillmentEndExclusive, true as scopeCovered,false as organizerScopeCovered,true as merchantScanPresent,f.fulfilled_at as merchantScanTime, false as groupEvidenceMatchesOrder,r.verification_time as verificationTime from coop_order_station_fulfillment f join cms_registration r on r.id=f.registration_id left join oms_ticket t on t.id=r.ticket_id and t.owner_type=r.owner_type and t.owner_id=r.owner_id and t.del_flag=0 and t.mode=1 and cast(t.sub_type as binary)=cast('guided' as binary) where f.order_id=#{snapshot.orderId} and f.topic_id=#{snapshot.topicId} and f.station_id=#{snapshot.billingStationId} and f.beneficiary_member_id=#{snapshot.beneficiaryId} and cast(f.order_terms_sha256 as binary)=cast(#{snapshot.orderTermsSha256} as binary) and r.owner_type=1 and r.owner_id=f.topic_id and f.fulfilled_at >= #{snapshot.fulfillmentStartInclusive} and f.fulfilled_at < #{settlementCutoff} order by r.id,f.id for update
